title: Connection inspection assignment
description: inspection_plan(request) returns selected_stations, station_count, connection_count. At least one endpoint of every declared connection must be selected. Return the fewest possible stations. If several such sets exist, choose the lexicographically smallest tuple of input positions, and emit station names in that order (not alphabetically). Repeated and reversed declarations describe one undirected connection; connection_count counts unique connections. Empty connections select no stations. Invalid requests raise ValueError; error message text is not part of the contract. Validate the entire request even after a valid prefix. Do not mutate the request. The program's JSON stdin/stdout entry point prints one response for valid requests; invalid input terminates with an error, not a success response.
